entities.summary: Savio Hon Tai-fai SDB is a Hong Konger Prelate who works in the diplomatic service of the Holy See. He served as secretary of the Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples from 2010 to 2017. Before that, he was a professor of theology at the Holy Spirit Seminary of Hong Kong.
